test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A conical tent is to accommodate 12 persons. Each person must have 5 m² of the space on the ground and 20 m³ of air to breathe. The height of the tent should be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Height (h)** of a cone can be directly calculated from the ratio of **Volume (V)** and **Base Area (A)**.

Volume of Cone = (1/3) × Base Area × Height

Height (h) = (3 × Total Volume) ÷ Total Base Area

Since both depend on the **number of persons**, the height is: h = (3 × Air per person) ÷ Ground space per person

h = (3 × 20) ÷ 5 = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 m

**∴ The correct answer is 12 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total persons = **12**

Ground space required per person = **5 m²**

Air required for breathing per person = **20 m³**

**Formula Used:**

Total Base Area = Number of persons × Area per person

Total Volume = Number of persons × Volume per person

Volume of Cone = (1/3) × πr²h (where πr² is the base area)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5a565d2f3ff71ba6f72c5bfdc19498a302824e1ed0f4bc507559ab2caa131a6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Base Area (πr²) = 12 × 5 = **60 m²**

⇒ Total Volume (V) = 12 × 20 = **240 m³**

⇒ Volume (V) = (1/3) × Base Area × Height (h)

⇒ 240 = (1/3) × 60 × h

⇒ 240 = 20 × h

⇒ h = 240 ÷ 20

⇒ h = **12 m**

**∴ The correct answer is 12 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

The volume of a cone is exactly **one-third** the volume of a cylinder with the same base radius and height: V = (1/3)πr²h.

Slant Height of a Cone

The relationship between height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) is given by the Pythagorean theorem: l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the **lateral surface** of a cone is given by the formula: CSA = πrl.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total area includes the base and the curved surface: TSA = πr(l + r).</p
